import datetime,hashlib,json,os,subprocess,traceback
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result,sha_file
from src.envs import pair_v2_simulator as engine
ROOT=Path.cwd().resolve()
NAME="diag_g01_new_baseline_failures_01"
assert os.environ.get("CVPR_RUN_NAME")==NAME
def require(v,msg):
 if not v: raise ValueError(msg)
def leafs(value,prefix=""):
 out={}
 for key,item in value.items():
  path=prefix+"."+key if prefix else key
  if isinstance(item,dict): out.update(leafs(item,path))
  else: out[path]=item
 return out
def compare_agent(before,after):
 a,b=leafs(before),leafs(after)
 rows={}
 for key in sorted(set(a)|set(b)):
  x,y=a.get(key),b.get(key)
  equal=engine.encoded(x)==engine.encoded(y)
  numeric=type(x) in (int,float) and type(y) in (int,float)
  rows[key]={"before":x,"after":y,"encoded_equal":equal,"numeric_delta":y-x if numeric else None,
   "before_hex":float(x).hex() if numeric else None,"after_hex":float(y).hex() if numeric else None,
   "signed_zero_only":bool(numeric and x==y==0 and not equal)}
 return rows
previous,previous_ref=audited_result(ROOT/"results/t01v2_restore_diag_supp6_01.json")
require(previous["_meta"]["exit_code"]==0 and previous["metrics"]["source_errors"]==[],"Earlier diagnosis did not complete")
previous_rows=[]
for row in previous["metrics"]["scenes"]:
 p=row["proposal_setup_failure"]
 previous_rows.append({"scene":row["scene"],"source_error":row["source_error"],
 "setup_reference":p["setup_reference"],"index_reference":p["index_reference"],
 "agent_difference_fields":p["agent_difference_fields"],"agent_has_numeric_difference":p["agent_has_numeric_difference"],
 "agent_difference_only_signed_zero":p["agent_difference_only_signed_zero"],
 "original_position_y_measurement":p["agent_axes"]["position.y"],
 "all_object_inventory_exact":p["all_object_inventory_exact"]})
records,errors=[],[]
for scene in ("FloorPlan18","FloorPlan214"):
 result_path=ROOT/"results"/("gen_train_next12_60_03_retry1_c6_"+scene.lower()+".json")
 output={"scene":scene,"status":"unknown"}
 records.append(output)
 try:
  data,source=audited_result(result_path)
  cfg,m,meta=data["config"],data["metrics"],data["_meta"]
  require(cfg["scene"]==scene and meta.get("end") and meta["exit_code"]==1 and m["attempts"]==0,
   "Wrong or unfinished original source")
  require(m["error"]=="RuntimeError: Canonical common baseline restoration failed before marked view discovery"
   and m["cleanup_errors"]==[] and m["final_metrics_verified"] is True and m["terminal_verified_after_cleanup"] is True,
   "Different failure or unknown cleanup/terminal proof")
  raw=Path(cfg["raw_evidence_dir"]).resolve()
  require("708409_hopper_m_02" in raw.parts and cfg["producer_module"]=="src.envs.pair_v2_g01_shard","Wrong original allocation/producer")
  original_code=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",meta["git_commit"]+":src/envs/pair_v2_simulator.py"])
  current_code=(ROOT/"src/envs/pair_v2_simulator.py").read_bytes()
  require(original_code==current_code,"Current restoration helper differs from actual source revision")
  visits=m["controller_visits"]
  require(len(visits)==1 and visits[0]["cleanup_errors"]==[],"Unexpected Controller history")
  visit=visits[0]
  def raw_read(ref):
   p=Path(ref["file"]).resolve()
   require(p.is_relative_to(raw),"Evidence escapes actual source")
   content=p.read_bytes()
   require(hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()==ref["sha256"],"SHA-mismatched original evidence: "+str(p))
   if "bytes" in ref: require(len(content)==ref["bytes"],"Original evidence size mismatch")
   return json.loads(content)
  index=raw_read(visit["raw_index"])
  indexed={str(Path(r["file"]).resolve()):r for r in index["files"]}
  require(len(indexed)==len(index["files"]),"Duplicate paths in sealed raw index")
  def read(ref):
   p=str(Path(ref["file"]).resolve())
   require(p in indexed and indexed[p]["sha256"]==ref["sha256"],"Reference absent from this Controller index")
   return raw_read(ref)
  preflight=read(visit["preflight_reference"])
  require(preflight["passed"] is True and preflight["reasons"]==[] and visit["preflight_passed"] is True,
   "This is a preflight exclusion rather than the reported restore failure")
  baseline=preflight["snapshot"]
  snap=read(baseline["reference"])
  require({k:v for k,v in baseline.items() if k!="reference"}==snap,"Preflight baseline differs from original snapshot")
  window=preflight["window_end_snapshot"]
  window_raw=read(window["reference"])
  require({k:v for k,v in window.items() if k!="reference"}==window_raw,"Window snapshot mismatch")
  initial=read(visit["initial_agent_setup_reference"])
  require(preflight["initial_agent_setup_reference"]==visit["initial_agent_setup_reference"],"Initial setup not bound to preflight")
  initial_action=read(initial["action_reference"])
  require(initial_action["action"]=="TeleportFull" and initial_action["exception"] is None
   and initial_action["after_metadata"]["lastActionSuccess"] is True,"Initial native canonical setup failed")
  require(engine.encoded(initial_action["arguments"])==engine.encoded(initial["actual_command"])==
   engine.encoded(snap["agent_setup_command"]),"Saved original canonical command changed")
  require(engine.encoded(engine.agent_pose(SimpleNamespace(metadata=initial_action["after_metadata"])))==
   engine.encoded(initial["actual_agent"]),"Initial readback differs from raw native action")
  restores=[r for r in index["files"] if Path(r["file"]).name.startswith("restore_") and Path(r["file"]).suffix==".json"]
  require(len(restores)==1,"Missing/ambiguous failed restore measurement")
  restore_ref=restores[0]; restore=read(restore_ref)
  restored=read(restore["restored_snapshot_reference"])
  last=read(restored["last_action_reference"])
  require(last["action"]=="TeleportFull" and last["exception"] is None and last["after_metadata"]["lastActionSuccess"] is True,
   "Restore terminal action failed")
  require(engine.encoded(last["arguments"])==engine.encoded(snap["agent_setup_command"])==
   engine.encoded(restore["executed_agent_setup_arguments"]),"Restore did not reuse the exact original executed canonical setup")
  require(restored["objects"]==last["after_metadata"]["objects"] and engine.encoded(restored["agent"])==
   engine.encoded(engine.agent_pose(SimpleNamespace(metadata=last["after_metadata"]))),"Restored snapshot differs from native terminal metadata")
  measured=engine.restoration_state(snap,last["after_metadata"]["objects"],
     engine.agent_pose(SimpleNamespace(metadata=last["after_metadata"])))
  require(all(engine.encoded(restore[k])==engine.encoded(v) for k,v in measured.items()),
   "Original failure measurement not reproduced by unchanged helper")
  require(measured["restore_deterministic"] is False,"No reproduced baseline failure")
  action_refs=[r for r in index["files"] if Path(r["file"]).name.startswith("action_") and Path(r["file"]).suffix==".json"]
  actions=[]
  for r in action_refs:
   a=read(r)
   if window_raw["last_action_reference"]["file"]==r["file"] or a["index"]>=last["index"]-3:
    actions.append((r,a))
  actions.sort(key=lambda item:item[1]["index"])
  require([a["action"] for _,a in actions]==["AdvancePhysicsStep","GetReachablePositions","PausePhysicsAutoSim","SetObjectPoses","TeleportFull"],
   "Unexpected restoration chain; report unknown rather than assume")
  for index_pos,(ref,a) in enumerate(actions):
   require(a["exception"] is None and a["after_metadata"]["lastActionSuccess"] is True,"Unsuccessful original restore prefix action")
   if index_pos:
    previous_action=actions[index_pos-1][1]
    require(a["index"]==previous_action["index"]+1 and a["before_metadata"]==previous_action["after_metadata"],
     "Actual native restore chain not contiguous")
  placement=actions[-2][1]
  require(placement["arguments"]["placeStationary"] is True and placement["arguments"]["objectPoses"]==snap["poses"],
   "Restore did not use complete baseline pose list")
  engine.complete_pose_list(placement["before_metadata"]["objects"],placement["arguments"]["objectPoses"])
  leaf_differences=compare_agent(snap["agent"],restored["agent"])
  chain=[]
  for ref,a in actions:
   before=engine.agent_pose(SimpleNamespace(metadata=a["before_metadata"]))
   after=engine.agent_pose(SimpleNamespace(metadata=a["after_metadata"]))
   pose=engine.pose_measurements(snap["objects"],a["after_metadata"]["objects"])
   chain.append({"reference":ref,"action":a["action"],"index":a["index"],"action_success":True,
     "agent_before":before,"agent_after":after,"agent_difference_fields":{k:v for k,v in compare_agent(before,after).items() if not v["encoded_equal"]},
     "inventory_exact":pose["inventory_exact"],"editable_inventory_exact":pose["editable_inventory_exact"],
     "max_editable_position_delta_from_baseline_m":max((r["position_delta_m"] for r in pose["objects"].values()),default=None)})
  pose=measured["pose_measurements"]
  output.update(status="diagnosed_from_original_native_evidence",source=source,
   raw_index_reference=visit["raw_index"],preflight_reference=visit["preflight_reference"],
   baseline_reference=baseline["reference"],window_end_reference=window["reference"],
   initial_canonical_setup_reference=visit["initial_agent_setup_reference"],initial_canonical_action_reference=initial["action_reference"],
   restore_reference=restore_ref,restored_snapshot_reference=restore["restored_snapshot_reference"],
   restore_native_action_reference=restored["last_action_reference"],controller_id=visit["controller_id"],
   worker_pid=visit["worker_pid"],unity_identity=visit["unity_identity"],
   original_status=m["status"],original_error=m["error"],attempts=m["attempts"],scene_excluded=m["scene_excluded"],
   preflight_measurements=visit["preflight_measurements"],
   full_inventory_exact=pose["inventory_exact"],editable_inventory_exact=pose["editable_inventory_exact"],
   missing=pose["missing"],added=pose["added"],editable_object_count=len(pose["objects"]),
   max_editable_position_delta_m=max((r["position_delta_m"] for r in pose["objects"].values()),default=None),
   restored_positions_within_1cm=measured["restored_positions_within_1cm"],agent_pose_exact=measured["agent_pose_exact"],
   restore_deterministic=measured["restore_deterministic"],
   agent_field_comparison=leaf_differences,agent_difference_fields={k:v for k,v in leaf_differences.items() if not v["encoded_equal"]},
   original_canonical_arguments=initial_action["arguments"],restore_arguments=last["arguments"],
   exact_original_arguments_reused=True,initial_native_agent=initial["actual_agent"],
   baseline_agent=snap["agent"],window_end_agent=window_raw["agent"],restored_agent=restored["agent"],
   original_restore_rgb_diagnostic={k:restore[k] for k in ("restore_max_abs_diff","restore_rgb_exact")},
   restore_RGB_scope="Original saved diagnostic only; RGB is not an input to this failing state predicate.",
   native_chain=chain,cleanup_errors=m["cleanup_errors"],final_metrics_verified=m["final_metrics_verified"],
   terminal_verified_after_cleanup=m["terminal_verified_after_cleanup"],
   restoration_helper={"file":"src/envs/pair_v2_simulator.py","sha256":hashlib.sha256(current_code).hexdigest(),
    "actual_source_git_commit":meta["git_commit"],"exact_source_revision_match":True},
   causal_scope="Locates observed metadata change to original successful TeleportFull and exact-state predicate. Does not identify Unity internal physics/numeric cause or demonstrate any safe fix.")
 except Exception as error:
  traceback.print_exc()
  output["error"]=type(error).__name__+": "+str(error)
  errors.append({"scene":scene,"error":output["error"]})
out={"at_utc":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 "scope":"Ended708409 original baseline/restore evidence only; no Unity, GPU, new measurement action, source mutation, acceptance change or fix",
 "scenes":records,"historical_diagnostic":previous_ref,"historical_comparison":previous_rows,
 "errors":errors,"thresholds_changed":False,"baseline_changed":False,"source_artifacts_modified":False,
 "GPU_used":False,"new_pair_acceptance":None}
print("G01_NEW_BASELINE_FAILURES_JSON: "+json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(1 if errors else 0)
